finding_text: A backup cycle wrote its heartbeat only when it finished. Repository discovery blocked for 22 minutes. Throughout that window the monitor saw an old heartbeat, and the five-minute scheduler could not start another instance.

With no environment override, the status command reads the repository-local state directory. It reports both heartbeats missing while the shared conductor state contains a recent watchdog heartbeat and healthcheck reads it.

With the conductor root unset, the watchdog dashboard selects a sibling directory containing a sweep log. It displays STALE while the daemon continues updating its heartbeat under the user's conductor directory.

To compare merge routes, an operator must retrieve PR histories and reconstruct CI attempts, fix rounds and contended files. The merge tools do not provide a per-PR contention report for that analysis.
Wave journals contain item timing records. Operators comparing wave latency have to calculate the p50 and p95 and estimate orchestration overhead themselves. There is no consolidated breakdown.
An operator can inspect token spending against a wave ceiling, but cannot obtain an end-of-wave spending forecast or an early threshold alert from those measurements.
